texts.facts: These writ petitions are filed seeking a writ of certiorari for quashing the notices at Annexure D1 to D6 and also for a writ of mandamus directing the second respondent to consider the applications filed by the petitioners on 16.01.2013, vide Annexure-E1 to E6. 2. All the petitioners have obtained a trade licence. They are all carrying the business of manufacture of mineral water. The 5th respondent has issued a notice to them asking them to produce ISI (BSI) certificate or acknowledgment for having applied for the same within 48 hours. It is made clear that if not produced they will take action under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 2006. 3. The grievance of the petitioners is that they have applied for grant of licence on 16.01.2013 by submitting all the relevant documents and fixed fees by depositing the same through D.D. before the 2nd respondent. These applications are pending for consideration. Petitioners have replied to the notice issued by the 5th respondent and they have requested them not to disturb their business pending disposal of their applications before the second respondent. However, again on 23.01.2013 the 5th respondent has issued notices to some of the petitioners asking them to close the business, and if the business is not closed they will disconnect the electricity supply of the business units of the petitioners and take action under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act. In these circumstances, they have preferred these writ petitions. 4. The question which is involved in these writ petitions was the subject matter of batch of writ petitions before the Principal Bench in W.P.No.17713/2012 and other connected matters. 2. W.P.Nos.17467-17498/2012 and W.P.Nos. 24257-283/2012 are hereby disposed of.
